name: Bam Bam's BBQ Central Texas Smoked Turkey Breast, Lean Brisket & Garlic Mashed Potatoes
brandOrRestaurant: Bam Bam's BBQ (Orem / Near BambooHR Lindon, UT)
whyItWorks: Just minutes from the BambooHR Lindon campus, Bam Bam's Central Texas-style post-oak-smoked Turkey Breast and Lean Brisket ("lean cut") are tender, un-sauced, and gluten-free.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Smoked Turkey Breast or Lean-Cut Brisket by the quarter/half pound with BBQ sauce on the side; scrape off any heavy coarse black-pepper bark edges and pair with a soft roll or potato salad/mashed potatoes.
watchOuts: Ask for "lean brisket" rather than "moist/fatty point cut" during sensitive days, and skip jalapeño cheddar sausage and raw coleslaw
